quizName:
Sign Test
									  					
									  														  					Check how well you know road signs.

questions.question: This is the shape and color of a ____ sign.
questions.explanation: Triangular signs pointing down mean you must yield. Slow down when you see this sign. Stop if you need to. If you stop, do so at the marked line or before the crosswalk.

questions.question: This sign means:

options.text: Right turn on red light permitted with caution.
All traffic must turn right at next intersection.

questions.explanation: A red circle with a line through it means you cannot do that action. This sign means no right turns are allowed.

questions.question: When displayed on the rear of a vehicle, this sign indicates:

options.text: The vehicle is being drawn by an animal.
The vehicle is traveling at speeds of 25 mph or slower.

questions.correctAnswerText: The vehicle is traveling at speeds of 25 mph or slower.
questions.explanation: Some slow vehicles like bicycles, horse-drawn vehicles, or farm equipment display this sign. It warns other drivers that the vehicle will only travel at 25 mph or slower.

questions.question: This road sign means:

options.text: The road ahead winds with a series of turns or curves.

questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns you to be careful in wet conditions. The road becomes slippery and harder to control your vehicle.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that you are leaving a divided road and entering a two-way highway with traffic in both directions.

questions.question: This red and white sign means you should:

options.text: Stop and check for traffic coming from both directions before proceeding.
Give the right-of-way to traffic on the road you wish to enter or cross.
Maintain a steady speed and check for traffic coming from all directions.

questions.correctAnswerText: Give the right-of-way to traffic on the road you wish to enter or cross.
questions.explanation: A three-sided yield sign means slow down and be ready to stop if needed. Let any vehicles, bicycles, or pedestrians pass first. You do not have the right-of-way.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign shows there is a pedestrian crosswalk ahead where people cross the road.

questions.question: This road sign means:

options.text: You must come to a complete stop.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must come to a complete stop.
questions.explanation: An octagonal sign always means stop. Come to a complete stop at the marked line. If there is no line, stop before the crosswalk. If there is no crosswalk, stop at a point where you can see oncoming traffic.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: A five-sided yellow or yellow-green sign alerts drivers to a school zone or school crossing ahead.

questions.question: This road sign means:
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign tells drivers to watch for people crossing the road.

questions.question: A sign with this shape means:
questions.explanation: A pennant-shaped sign marks the start of a no passing zone.

questions.question: This sign warns drivers that:

options.text: The right lane is ending and traffic should merge left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The right lane is ending and traffic should merge left.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They alert you to conditions right ahead. This sign tells drivers that one lane is ending and traffic must merge left.

questions.question: This yellow sign means:

options.text: Be prepared to stop if the light is flashing.
There is a traffic signal ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: There is a traffic signal ahead.
questions.explanation: A yellow sign showing a traffic signal means a traffic signal is ahead. Be ready to respond to it.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign warns you of a winding road ahead.

questions.question: This sign indicates:

options.text: An upcoming construction or maintenance area.

questions.correctAnswerText: An upcoming construction or maintenance area.
questions.explanation: Diamond-shaped signs warn drivers about hazards or special conditions ahead. Construction areas are usually marked with orange warning signs.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot make a U-turn. You cannot turn around to go in the opposite direction at this location.

questions.question: This sign means:

options.text: No left turn can be made here.
A left turn can be made only after stopping.
All traffic must turn right at the next intersection.

questions.correctAnswerText: No left turn can be made here.
questions.explanation: A red circle with a line through a symbol means that action is not allowed. This sign means left turns are prohibited.

questions.question: This road sign means:
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings and alert you to upcoming situations. This sign tells drivers the right lane is ending and to prepare for merging traffic.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: A triangular red and white sign means you must yield the right-of-way.

questions.question: This sign means:

options.text: Cars on the right move first.
Let cross traffic pass before proceeding.

questions.correctAnswerText: Let cross traffic pass before proceeding.
questions.explanation: This sign means you must yield the right-of-way. Slow down and let vehicles and pedestrians cross before you proceed. Stop if needed.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: A sharp right turn is ahead.
A road joins from the right.
The road turns sharply right, then sharply left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road turns sharply right, then sharply left.
questions.explanation: Yellow signs with black markings warn of road conditions ahead. This sign tells you the road will curve sharply to the right and then sharply to the left.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Right turns are allowed on a red light.

questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot turn right. It is illegal to turn right at this intersection.

questions.question: What does this sign show?
questions.explanation: Yellow signs with black markings warn drivers of conditions ahead. This sign warns that another road crosses the highway ahead.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: Yellow signs with black markings warn of road conditions ahead. This sign warns you of a steep hill. Slow down and use a lower gear to control your speed and protect your brakes.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign is displayed on vehicles that move slowly on the road.

questions.question: What does a diamond-shaped sign mean?
questions.explanation: Diamond-shaped signs warn drivers of hazards or special conditions ahead. They are yellow or orange.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Stop only if other cars are approaching.

questions.explanation: Yellow signs with black markings warn drivers of conditions ahead. This sign alerts you to areas where bicycles may cross the road.

questions.question: What turn is this bicyclist signaling?
questions.explanation: Bicycles use hand signals instead of turn signals. A straight left arm means the bicyclist is turning left.

questions.question: You see a red left arrow at a traffic signal. What should you do if you want to turn left?

options.text: Turn, as long as you yield to other drivers.
Stop completely, then proceed when it is safe.
Stop completely and stay stopped while the red arrow is on.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop completely and stay stopped while the red arrow is on.
questions.explanation: A red left arrow means you must stop before the intersection. Do not turn. Stay stopped until the red arrow is gone.

questions.question: What should you do when you see a school crossing sign?

options.text: Always stop, whether or not there is a stop sign.
Watch for children and be ready to stop.
Always honk your horn when you see children.

questions.correctAnswerText: Watch for children and be ready to stop.
questions.explanation: A five-sided sign means you are near a school zone or school crossing. Stay alert and be prepared to stop for children.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: You must drive through the intersection at the posted speed limit.
The highest speed allowed under normal conditions is 55 mph.
You cannot drive slower than the posted speed.

questions.correctAnswerText: The highest speed allowed under normal conditions is 55 mph.
questions.explanation: Speed limit signs tell you the maximum speed allowed on that road. You can drive slower based on road conditions, but you cannot drive faster than the posted limit.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Road construction or maintenance work ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: Road construction or maintenance work ahead.
questions.explanation: Diamond-shaped signs warn of hazards. Orange signs are used in construction and maintenance areas.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road is slippery when wet.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road is slippery when wet.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings. They alert you to hazards just ahead. This sign warns that the road is slippery when wet.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: A downgrade or hill is coming.

questions.correctAnswerText: A downgrade or hill is coming.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you of a steep or long hill ahead. The hill may have sharp curves.

questions.question: What information do blue traffic signs provide?
questions.explanation: Blue signs provide information about motorist services such as rest areas, food, and hospitals.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that a stop sign is coming up ahead.

questions.question: What should you do when you see this sign?

options.text: Look for a train station ahead.
Slow down and let trains pass.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and let trains pass.
questions.explanation: A round sign means a railroad crossing is nearby. This sign is posted a few hundred feet before the tracks. It tells drivers to slow down, look, listen, and be ready to stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road is slippery when wet.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road is slippery when wet.
questions.explanation: Wet roads are dangerous and slippery. This sign warns drivers to slow down because it takes longer to stop on wet pavement.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Last turn before a toll road.

questions.explanation: Orange signs indicate work zones. Stay alert and be ready for unexpected conditions. This sign warns that a flagger is ahead, and you must follow their directions.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: The road curves left then right.
The road curves right then left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road curves right then left.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings. This sign warns that the road will curve right first, then curve left. Slow down to drive safely through these curves.

questions.question: What does this white sign mean?

options.text: Do not pass until after you see the sign.
Do not pass unless it looks safe.
Do not pass for any reason.

questions.correctAnswerText: Do not pass for any reason.
questions.explanation: A white rectangular sign means you must follow the rule shown. This sign means you cannot pass other vehicles under any circumstances.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that a side road crosses ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a yield sign is coming. Start slowing down when you see this warning.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Stop and let pedestrians and other traffic go first.
Stop and then go right away.
Slow down and get ready to stop.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop and let pedestrians and other traffic go first.
questions.explanation: Come to a complete stop at this sign. Stop at the marked line or before the crosswalk. Let other vehicles and pedestrians pass, then go.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A round yellow sign warns you that a railroad crossing is coming.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings. They tell you about something ahead. This sign warns you that an intersection is coming so you can prepare for traffic or turns.

questions.question: When you see this sign, you should stop and:

options.text: Look only in the direction you are going, then go.
Let all vehicles that arrive before or after you go first.

questions.explanation: At a stop sign, come to a complete stop and look in all directions before you go.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Reserved parking for persons with disabilities.

questions.explanation: This sign warns that two lanes going the same way will soon become one lane.

questions.question: What does this yellow sign mean?

options.text: Right turn only on green arrow.

questions.explanation: Some warning signs have bright yellow-green backgrounds. These signs warn you about upcoming road conditions like curves and sharp turns.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign marks a crosswalk. Watch for pedestrians crossing the road.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: A side road is coming up ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: A side road is coming up ahead.
questions.explanation: This is a yellow warning sign with black markings. It tells drivers to watch for a side road that will cross ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign tell a driver?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a flagger is ahead. Always follow their directions. Flaggers wear orange or yellow vests and use paddles and flags to direct traffic through work zones.

questions.question: What does this black and yellow sign mean?

options.text: The road to the right is one-way only.
There is a detour to the right due to construction.
The road ahead makes a sharp, extreme turn.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead makes a sharp, extreme turn.
questions.explanation: This yellow and black warning sign tells you the road ahead will turn sharply. Slow down and prepare for the sudden change in direction.

questions.question: What is this symbol used for?
questions.explanation: An orange triangle on the back of a vehicle means it moves slowly. You may see this on farm equipment, roadwork vehicles, or horse-drawn wagons. It looks orange during the day and red at night.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Traffic is merging from the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: Traffic is merging from the right.
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign tells drivers that traffic will merge from the right. Be ready to let traffic safely join your lane.

questions.question: What does this yellow warning sign mean?

options.text: A school or school crosswalk is ahead.
Slow down, drive carefully, and watch for children.

questions.explanation: This sign is placed near schools. It warns drivers to slow down and watch for children.

questions.question: What is the correct order of traffic lights from top to bottom?
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign tells drivers that a traffic signal is ahead. Traffic lights are always ordered from top to bottom: red, yellow, green.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Slow down; a curved road is ahead.
Slow down and do not use your brakes.
Slow down; the road is slippery when wet.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down; the road is slippery when wet.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road becomes slippery when it rains or is wet.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means the right lane is ending soon. Drivers in that lane must merge into another lane.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Be ready for traffic to merge into your lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: Be ready for traffic to merge into your lane.
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign tells drivers that traffic will merge in from the right. Allow space for the merging traffic.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: Pentagon-shaped signs show you are in or near a school zone or school crossing. Drive slowly and watch for children. Follow the posted speed limits.

questions.question: This road sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign shows a traffic law you must follow. You cannot turn right where this sign is posted.

questions.question: This sign means:

options.text: Watch for vehicles entering from the side.

questions.explanation: This sign warns you that the road ahead is divided by an island or barrier.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign warns of a steep hill going down ahead. Check your brakes before proceeding.

questions.question: This sign means:

options.text: Reserved parking for persons with disabilities.

questions.correctAnswerText: Reserved parking for persons with disabilities.
questions.explanation: This sign marks parking spaces reserved for vehicles with disability license plates or disability placards.

questions.question: This sign tells you that:

options.text: No turns are allowed on the road.
There is a series of curves ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: There is a series of curves ahead.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns you about multiple curves ahead on the road.

questions.question: This road sign means:

options.text: You are not allowed to travel in this direction.

questions.correctAnswerText: You are not allowed to travel in this direction.
questions.explanation: Red signs show that something is not allowed. This sign means you are going the wrong way. Turn around immediately.

questions.question: This sign shows one type of:
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns that your road ends at an intersection ahead. Slow down and be ready to yield or stop before turning.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns that the divided highway is ending ahead. Get ready to change lanes.

questions.question: This road sign means:

options.text: Drive only in the direction of the arrow.

questions.correctAnswerText: Drive only in the direction of the arrow.
questions.explanation: This sign shows a traffic law you must follow. Drive only in the direction the arrow points.

questions.question: An orange and red triangular sign on a vehicle means:
questions.explanation: Slow-moving vehicles display an orange and red triangle on the back. Examples include farm tractors, road maintenance vehicles, and animal-drawn carts.

questions.question: This sign means:

options.text: There is a 35 mph speed zone after the curve ahead.
Drive no slower than 35 mph around the upcoming curve.
Slow down to 35 mph or less before the upcoming curve.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down to 35 mph or less before the upcoming curve.
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs alert you to conditions ahead. A speed advisory plaque on the sign tells you the safe speed for that area.

questions.question: This sign means:

options.text: You should stop for other traffic.
Traffic is merging from another road. Give them space to merge safely.
Traffic is entering from another road and you should keep right.

questions.correctAnswerText: Traffic is merging from another road. Give them space to merge safely.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that traffic will merge into your lane. Check your mirrors and side areas, then move to another lane if possible to give merging drivers room.

questions.question: This white sign means:

options.text: You should slow down and move to the right lane.
If you are driving slower than other traffic, stay in the right lane.
Slower traffic must exit on the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: If you are driving slower than other traffic, stay in the right lane.
questions.explanation: White rectangular signs show rules you must follow. This sign means slower drivers should use the right lane so the left lane stays open for passing and faster traffic.

questions.question: This sign means:

options.text: Slow down and yield to traffic on the main road when merging.
Always come to a complete stop.
Activate your turn signal and proceed at normal speed.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and yield to traffic on the main road when merging.
questions.explanation: A yield sign tells you to slow down and let other vehicles pass before you enter the intersection. You do not always need to stop completely, but always slow down and enter carefully.

questions.question: This white sign means you:

options.text: May turn left only on a green arrow.
May turn left on a green light when it is safe.
Must wait for the solid green light before you turn left.

questions.correctAnswerText: May turn left on a green light when it is safe.
questions.explanation: A "yield" sign means you must slow down and be ready to stop for any vehicles, bicycles, or pedestrians. After you yield, you can follow the rest of the sign's instructions.

questions.question: If you approach a flashing red traffic light, you:

options.text: Are traveling in the wrong direction.
Must treat it like a stop sign.
May not proceed until it changes to green.

questions.correctAnswerText: Must treat it like a stop sign.
questions.explanation: Treat a flashing red light the same as a stop sign. Come to a complete stop, then yield to all other traffic and pedestrians before proceeding.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that U-turns are not allowed in this area.

questions.question: This road sign means:

options.text: You are about to enter a one-way street from the wrong direction.
You may proceed if the way is clear.

questions.correctAnswerText: You are about to enter a one-way street from the wrong direction.
questions.explanation: This sign marks a one-way road, entrance, or exit. If you see this sign facing you, traffic moves in the opposite direction. Turn around immediately.

questions.question: This sign means that you:

options.text: May turn left or continue straight.

questions.correctAnswerText: May turn left or continue straight.
questions.explanation: This sign shows that your lane splits into two directions. You can either turn left or continue straight ahead.

questions.question: What sign is this?
questions.explanation: A downward-pointing triangle is always a yield sign. You must be ready to slow down or stop when you see it.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot turn left. It is illegal to turn left where this sign is posted.

questions.question: What should you do when you see this sign?

options.text: Watch for traffic merging from the right

questions.correctAnswerText: Watch for traffic merging from the right
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs alert you to hazards ahead. This sign warns you that traffic may merge into your lane from the right.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: You must go either right or left

questions.correctAnswerText: You must go either right or left
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs have black markings. This sign warns you that the road splits ahead and you must choose to go right or left.

questions.question: What should you do when you see this yellow sign?

options.text: Stop at the crosswalk until a crossing guard signals you to go
Be ready to stop if children are in the crosswalk

questions.correctAnswerText: Be ready to stop if children are in the crosswalk
questions.explanation: A five-sided sign means you are near a school. Watch for children and stop if they are crossing.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs have black markings. These signs warn you that animals, people, or bicycles may cross your path.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means U-turns are not allowed. You may see this sign at intersections with heavy oncoming traffic.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs have black markings. This sign warns you of a crosswalk. Stay alert and let pedestrians cross safely.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You are approaching the end of a divided highway
You are approaching the start of a divided highway
The road will be slippery ahead

questions.correctAnswerText: You are approaching the start of a divided highway
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a divided highway is starting. Stay to the right of the median.

questions.question: What does an orange sign like this mean?
questions.explanation: Orange signs warn about construction zones. Drive carefully and watch for workers and equipment.

questions.question: What should you do when you see this road sign?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign tells you a divided highway is starting. Stay in the right lane.

questions.question: What does this white sign mean?

options.text: The railroad crossing is controlled. Keep your regular speed.
Look and listen. Be ready to stop if needed.
Stop at the railroad tracks. Wait for a signal before crossing.

questions.correctAnswerText: Look and listen. Be ready to stop if needed.
questions.explanation: At a railroad crossing, you must look, listen, slow down, and be ready to stop. Let any trains pass before you go.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Drive carefully and be ready to stop.
You must come to a complete stop.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must come to a complete stop.
questions.explanation: The stop sign is the only eight-sided sign on roadways. You must come to a complete stop. Do not go until it is safe to pass through the intersection.

questions.question: What should you do at a flashing yellow light?

options.text: Slow down and proceed with caution.
Come to a complete stop as quickly as possible.
Stop and proceed only when the intersection is clear.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and proceed with caution.
questions.explanation: At a flashing yellow light, slow down and proceed with caution. You do not have to come to a complete stop.

questions.question: What does this yellow sign mean?

options.text: The road ahead has many curves.
There is a sharp curve in the road ahead.
The road ahead may be slippery.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead may be slippery.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road ahead may be slippery when wet.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: An eight-sided red sign means stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a traffic signal is coming.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You can travel in either direction in this lane.
You are approaching a divided highway.

questions.explanation: This sign warns you about two-way traffic.

questions.question: What does this sign indicate?
questions.explanation: Yellow signs with black markings warn drivers about hazards or special conditions. Round signs warn only about railroad crossings.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Reserved parking for persons with disabilities.

questions.explanation: This sign is posted on one-way streets and roads where you cannot enter. You may see it if you try to go the wrong way on an expressway ramp.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A round sign means a railroad crossing is coming.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot turn in the direction the arrow points. In this case, you cannot turn right.

questions.question: What does this sign tell you about the road ahead?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road will curve right and then curve left.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs have black markings. This sign warns of a steep hill coming. Slow down to avoid crashes and brake problems.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Change in direction or narrowing of roadway.

questions.correctAnswerText: Change in direction or narrowing of roadway.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road direction is changing or the road is getting narrower. You may see these signs on sharp curves or before narrow bridges.

questions.question: When you see this sign, what should you do?

options.text: A railroad crossing is coming. Be ready to stop.
You will always have to stop at the railroad crossing.
Stop and wait for a signal before crossing the tracks.

questions.correctAnswerText: A railroad crossing is coming. Be ready to stop.
questions.explanation: This sign means a railroad crossing is ahead. Look and listen. Slow down and be ready to stop. Wait for trains to pass before you cross.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means a divided highway is starting ahead.

questions.question: What does this yellow sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that traffic may merge into your lane ahead.
